# Exact versions for the lint job in .github/workflows/test.yml. mypy's verdict
# depends on the type information that click, fastapi, pydantic, starlette,
# httpx and the rest ship, so CI installs the same versions as the maintainer's
# machine instead of whatever is newest; a new upstream release then cannot turn
# the job red on its own. Upgrading any of these is a commit of its own.
# The list is every distribution `pip install -e ".[dev]"` installs on Linux.
